mentions.name: Micro-positing microscopy stage
mentions.description: A microscopy stage project providing micro-positing via Nanomotion piezoelectric motors used outside their intended manner; the piezoelectric driver PCB design is being tweaked to push the limits of the technology.
mentions.source_excerpt: Tweaking the piezoelectric driver PCB design for the micro-positing microscopy stage project. The Nanomotion piezoelectric motors were not meant to be used in the manner I chose, but it is fun to push the limits of technology.

evidence.value: Tweaking the piezoelectric driver PCB design for the micro-positing microscopy stage project. The Nanomotion piezoelectric motors were not meant to be used in the manner I chose, but it is fun to push the limits of technology.
